title: EQL: Fix bug in sequences with any pattern

timeline.body:
Fix query creation inside sequences with any queries due to lacking a
clause to combine, which lead to an invalid request being created.

Fix #62967
I've sneaked this in since it affects running DataLoader#main instead of from a test.
Moved this to the base class.
The actual cause of the exception
